open ℚ public

qNatToℤ : Nat -> ℤ
qNatToℤ zero = pos zero
qNatToℤ (suc n) = pos (suc n)

ℕ→ℤ : Nat -> ℤ
ℕ→ℤ zero = pos zero
ℕ→ℤ (suc n) = pos (suc n)

absℤ : ℤ -> Nat
absℤ (pos n) = n
absℤ (negsuc n) = suc n

_≟ℚ_ : (q1 q2 : ℚ) → Dec (q1 ≡ q2)
mkℚ n1 d1 _ _ ≟ℚ mkℚ n2 d2 _ _ with n1 ≟ n2 | d1 ≟ d2
... | yes p | yes q = yes (cong₂ (λ num den → mkℚ num den (≤-refl) (refl)) p q)
... | no p | _ = no (λ eq → contradiction (cong ℚ.num eq) p)
... | _ | no q = no (λ eq → contradiction (cong ℚ.den eq) q)

div-helper : ∀ a b → b ≠ zero → div a b * b + a mod b ≡ a
div-helper zero b nz = sym (+-identityˡ (pos zero))
div-helper (suc a) (suc b) nz = ?

normalize-helper : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
normalize-helper n d = let g = gcd n d in div n g
  where
    gcd : Nat -> Nat -> Nat
    gcd zero d = d
    gcd (suc n) zero = suc n
    gcd (suc n) (suc d) = if (suc n) <? (suc d) then gcd (suc n) ((suc d) mod (suc n)) else gcd ((suc n) mod (suc d)) (suc d)

gcd-spec-1 : ∀ a b → gcd a b ≤ a
gcd-spec-1 zero b = ≤-refl
gcd-spec-1 (suc a) zero = ≤-refl
gcd-spec-1 (suc a) (suc b) with (suc a) <? (suc b)
... | true = gcd-spec-1 (suc a) ((suc b) mod (suc a))
... | false = gcd-spec-1 ((suc a) mod (suc b)) (suc b)

normalize-helper-spec : ∀ n → 1 ≤ normalize-helper n (suc zero)
normalize-helper-spec n = m≤n+m 1 0

normalize : ℤ -> Nat -> ℚ
normalize n d = let g = gcd (absℤ n) d
                   num' = div n (ℕ→ℤ g)
                   den' = div d g
                   coprime-proof = lemma-coprime n d g
               in mkℚ num' den' (normalize-helper-spec d) coprime-proof
  where
    lemma-coprime : ∀ n d g → g ≡ gcd (absℤ n) d → gcd (absℤ (div n (ℕ→ℤ g))) (div d g) ≡ 1
    lemma-coprime n d g eq = ?

Invariant : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph -> Set
Invariant g = (AllKeys (nodes g)) × (EdgesValid (edges g) (nodes g)) × (RegisterValid (quantum_register g) (nodes g))
  where
    AllKeys : NodeMap -> Set
    AllKeys [] = ⊤
    AllKeys ((k , v) ∷ rest) = (k ≡ Node.id v) × AllKeys rest
    
    EdgesValid : EdgeMap -> NodeMap -> Set
    EdgesValid [] _ = ⊤
    EdgesValid ((s , t , es) ∷ rest) nm = ((s ∈ map proj₁ nm) ∧ (t ∈ map proj₁ nm)) × EdgesValid rest nm
    
    RegisterValid : QReg -> NodeMap -> Set
    RegisterValid [] _ = ⊤
    RegisterValid ((k , q) ∷ rest) nm = (k ∈ map proj₁ nm) × RegisterValid rest nm

fnv1aString : List Char -> Nat

updateTopologyHash : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph -> SelfSimilarRelationalGraph
updateTopologyHash g = let hNodes = foldl (λ acc (_ , n) -> mod (acc + fnv1aString (Node.id n) + fnv1aString (Node.data n)) 2147483647) 0 (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.nodes g)
                           hEdges = foldl (λ acc (_ , _ , lst) -> mod (acc + foldl (λ a e -> mod (a + fnv1aString (Edge.source e) + fnv1aString (Edge.target e)) 2147483647) 0 lst) 2147483647) 0 (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.edges g)
                           hEnt = foldl (λ acc (a , b , _) -> mod (acc + fnv1aString a + fnv1aString b) 2147483647) 0 (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.entanglements g)
                           finalHash = mod (hNodes + hEdges + hEnt) 2147483647
                       in record g { topology_hash = map fromNat (map (mod _ 16) (foldr (λ n acc -> (mod n 16) ∷ acc) [] (finalHash ∷ finalHash ∷ []))) }

addNode : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph -> Node -> SelfSimilarRelationalGraph
addNode g node = let nid = Node.id node
                     nmap' = nmInsert nid node (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.nodes g)
                     qreg' = qrInsert nid (Node.qubit node) (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.quantum_register g)
                     inv' = nmInsert-preserves-inv nid (Node.qubit node) g (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.inv g)
                 in updateTopologyHash (record g { nodes = nmap' ; quantum_register = qreg' ; inv = inv' })

addEdge : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph -> List Char -> List Char -> Edge -> SelfSimilarRelationalGraph
addEdge g src tgt edge = let emap' = emInsert src tgt edge (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.edges g)
                         in updateTopologyHash (record g { edges = emap' })

setQuantumState : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph -> List Char -> Qubit -> SelfSimilarRelationalGraph
setQuantumState g nid q = case nmLookup nid (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.nodes g) of λ {
    nothing -> g ;
    (just n) -> let n' = record n { qubit = q }
                     nmap' = nmInsert nid n' (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.nodes g)
                     qreg' = qrInsert nid q (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.quantum_register g)
                     inv1 = nmInsert-preserves-inv nid n' g (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.inv g)
                     inv2 = qrInsert-preserves-inv nid q (record g { nodes = nmap' ; inv = inv1 }) inv1
                 in updateTopologyHash (record g { nodes = nmap' ; quantum_register = qreg' ; inv = inv2 })
  }

getQuantumState g nid = qrLookup nid (SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.quantum_register g)

applyQuantumGate : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph -> List Char -> (Qubit -> Qubit) -> SelfSimilarRelationalGraph
applyQuantumGate g nid gate = case getQuantumState g nid of λ {

    (just q) -> setQuantumState g nid (gate q)
  }

                              e2 = edge bid aid entangled q1 c1 q0 []
                              g' = addEdge g aid bid e1
                              g'' = addEdge g' bid aid e2
                          in record g'' { entanglements = emap' }
